info.description: This API allows users to retrieve credit check information for credit card applications. It provides detailed insights into the status and evaluation of applications, essential for risk assessment and decision-making. Typically utilized by financial institutions and credit analysts, the API serves as a key resource for monitoring application processes and ensuring compliance with credit regulations. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their credit evaluation workflow and improve operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve credit check details for applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the credit check information associated with specific applications. It provides insights into the creditworthiness of applicants, helping to make informed decisions during the application process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a credit check for applications. It should contain the necessary details required for processing a credit check.
